purpose: Read-only archive audit of overlooked masks, material tracks and alpha handling for V6-based production. Requested Astra audit; no archive code execution.

Small silhouette/contact shadows are already imported. The separate receiver-constrained shadow is only a candidate, and no general superior replacement for V6 or new continuous physical turn is established.

candidates.classification: Concrete preserved reusable data; benefit for new V6-based assembly remains conditional
candidates.finding: P4 C1 has 360 records with separate one-channel coverage/hand/shoe masks and compressed float32 UV fields. P4 C2 has 360 records with R=C1, G=C2 paper coverage and B=protected hand/next-shoe guard. Adapters bind exact source hashes, reject paper/guard overlap and keep geometry separate from artwork. This is more reusable than extracting a new mask from an already printed movie.
candidates.currentGap: These per-slot source tracks/adapters are absent from current src and manifest. Current V6 already has its own mesh, nail guards and manual hand-occlusion data, so this is expansion to original bank clips, not recovery of missing V6 guards.
limitations: P4 C1 review explicitly rejects dark full-surface/SG-back acceptance because a warm-shadow tab remains at frames176-212.

method.overview: Original zero-based frames0..348 step12 for each source
method.continuity: Every source frame is present within the critical ranges, without retiming/interpolation; overview outside these ranges is sampled, not full-frame certification.

c1.hand: Dealer left hand, seen on viewer right
observations: Frames38-48: held card rises out of the shoe; narrow visible shape is extraction/foreshortening against another white card, not a verified free side reversal.
Frames49-60: exposed paper broadens continuously as it clears the shoe.
Overview60,72,84,96,108,120 onward: broad face continues toward the table; no visible separate turn established.
Frames211-219: fingertips separate from the landed card while it remains stationary; clear gap by216 in this crop.
c1.minimumFix: Do not change C1 sidePolicy from all FRONT to a timed BACK/FRONT swap. A source movement with a verified turn, or independently verified continuous join to one, is required. Do not relabel extraction as flip.

c2.hand: Dealer left hand, seen on viewer right
observations: Frames76-83: carried broad white face narrows continuously toward an edge.
Frames84-98: sustained thin edge/green-reflected strip in a continuous held-card path; this is a phase, not merely one frame98.
Frames99-106: white paper widens again into the landing-facing plane; no broad-face colour switch is needed.
Frames211-219: moving-card fingertip release occurs around214-218; both landed white cards persist.

This interval needs native renderer validation before acceptance.
